summary.text: Stephanie Berault is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives, representing District 76 (St. Tammany Parish), and was elected in 2023, according to the official House member page.

paragraphs.text: The member page lists Stephanie Berault's occupation as Executive Director, HeartGift Louisiana.
It lists education as B.S., Business Administration, University of Southern Mississippi.

The page lists committee assignments including Appropriations, Health and Welfare, Retirement, the Joint Medicaid Oversight Committee, the Joint Legislative Committee on the Budget, the Legislative Audit Advisory Council and the House Select Committee on Women and Children, and caucus affiliations including the Louisiana Legislative Women's Caucus, the Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation, the Louisiana Rural Caucus and the Northshore Delegation.
